sources.title: Current Warden biography: 1991 Rhodes Scholarship and journalism career
sources.findings: Read the current Rhodes House Warden biography. It identifies Freeland as an Alberta-born Rhodes Scholar who came to Oxford in 1991 and describes her earlier journalism and editorial work at the Financial Times, Globe and Mail and Thomson Reuters. The 1991 date is her arrival as a scholar, not an inferred graduation date. A 2023 Northeastern honorary degree is not treated as an earned doctorate. Historical media jobs are not current appointments.

sources.publisher: The Canadian Press / Dylan Robertson, via CollingwoodToday
sources.title: 19 January 2025 biographical profile: birth, education and federal finance appointment
sources.findings: Read Dylan Robertson’s Canadian Press profile dated 19 January 2025, republished by CollingwoodToday. It gives birth on 2 August 1968 in Peace River, Alberta; earlier education and journalism; election in 2013; and appointment as Canada’s first woman federal finance minister in 2020. Its leadership-candidate context belongs to January 2025 and is not a current leadership office. Pandemic spending is government policy, not a personal causal claim about all economic outcomes. Family details are unnecessary and omitted.

sources.title: April 2007 biography: Harvard bachelor’s degree and Oxford Master of Studies
sources.findings: Read Columbia World Leaders Forum biography, explicitly sourced to April 2007. It establishes a Harvard bachelor’s degree in history and literature and a Master of Studies at St Antony’s College, Oxford. Neither degree’s graduation year is stated. MSt is retained by its actual degree name, not reclassified as a doctorate or a research-only degree. Its then-current FT position and New York residence are historical, despite the website’s 2026 footer. The page’s first-book title variant is not reused.

sources.title: Current and past roles: constituencies, ministerial offices and end of parliamentary service
sources.findings: Read the House of Commons roles tables. Toronto Centre service began 25 November 2013; University—Rosedale service began 19 October 2015 and ended 9 January 2026. The table lists Finance from 18 August 2020 and Deputy Prime Minister from 20 November 2019, both ending 15 December 2024; the public resignation announcement on 16 December is recorded separately. Transport and Internal Trade ran from 14 March to 16 September 2025, split into rows at the new parliament rather than a gap in service. Special Representative for the Reconstruction of Ukraine, listed as a parliamentary-secretary role, ran 16 September 2025 to 5 January 2026. She is no longer an MP. These Canadian offices are distinct from advising the Ukrainian president.

sources.title: 1 July 2026: Chrystia Freeland starts as new Warden and CEO
sources.findings: Read the Rhodes Trust release of 1 July 2026, explicitly stating that she starts today as Warden of Rhodes House and CEO of the Trust. She succeeds interim Warden/CEO Sir Rick Trainor, who had served since 1 January 2025 and remains as Provost. Do not describe her as merely incoming after July, as directly succeeding Elizabeth Kiss, or as head of the University of Oxford. The Trust is a scholarship charity.

sources.title: 13 November 2026: gift announced on 7 November extends Forum support to 2030
sources.findings: Read the Rhodes Trust report published 13 November 2026. Kevin Xu’s gift was announced at the fifth Tech & Society Forum on 7 November; it extends a partnership begun in 2022 through 2030. The report quotes Freeland as current Warden and CEO. Abhilash Mishra conceived the gathering and developed it with Trust leadership; Xu funded its launch. Do not credit her with founding the Forum, making the gift or delivering all future results. Her quotation establishes a dated institutional statement, not independent proof of physical attendance on 7 November.

sources.publisher: Government of Canada, Orders in Council
sources.title: P.C. 2026-0001 of 9 January: termination of parliamentary-secretary appointment effective 5 January 2026
sources.findings: Read Order in Council P.C. 2026-0001, dated 9 January 2026. It terminates her parliamentary-secretary appointment effective 5 January 2026, referring to appointment P.C. 2025-0661 of 16 September 2025. The order’s publication/signature date is distinct from its effective date and from the MP term ending on 9 January. Cross-check with the Commons role label rather than treating every appointment involving Ukraine as the same office.

sources.title: 5 January 2026: Zelenskiy appoints Freeland as economic development adviser
sources.findings: Read Reuters’ 5 January 2026 report, including Zelenskiy’s appointment announcement and Freeland’s statement that she would advise on economic development without pay. It then described her MP departure as future; the Commons record subsequently confirms 9 January. Retain the January appointment as historical, not an independently verified continuing November advisory mandate. The Ukrainian presidential decree page could not be read beyond navigation before repeated timeouts, so no assertion of full decree inspection or its precise legal category is made.

sources.title: 18 August 2020: finance appointment while retaining deputy prime minister role
sources.findings: Read the archived Canadian prime ministerial release of 18 August 2020. It appoints Freeland to Finance while retaining her Deputy Prime Minister office and notes her role in NAFTA renegotiation and the government’s COVID response. Recovery language is a prospective remit, not evidence that particular economic outcomes had already been achieved. Bill Morneau’s earlier measures are not reassigned to Freeland.

sources.title: 16 December 2024: finance minister resigns after policy clash with Trudeau
sources.findings: Read the contemporaneous Reuters report of 16 December 2024 as republished by Kitco, including the relevant paragraphs on the fiscal-update schedule, spending disagreement, possible US tariffs and resignation letter. Her assessment of spending and tariff risks is explicitly attributed, not adopted as a finding of policy failure or corruption. Retain the public announcement date alongside the Commons table’s 15 December term endpoint. This historical story does not establish Trudeau or other officials’ current offices.

sources.title: CUSMA Canadian Statement on Implementation: introduction and treaty chronology
sources.findings: Read the introduction and purpose section of Global Affairs Canada’s CUSMA Statement on Implementation. It distinguishes signature on 30 November 2018, amendment on 10 December 2019, completion notices in April 2020 and entry into force on 1 July 2020. Combine treaty chronology with the prime ministerial biography for her negotiating involvement. Preserve the collective roles of three governments and negotiating teams; do not identify her as sole author or assume signature itself brought the agreement into force. Government claims of expected benefits are not independent measurements; the full chapter-by-chapter legal text was not reviewed.

sources.title: Unreliable Boyfriend: hardcover publication metadata, 13 October 2026, ISBN 9781668245903
sources.findings: Read Simon & Schuster Canada’s product details and author description for Unreliable Boyfriend, hardcover ISBN 9781668245903. The listed publication date is 13 October 2026, distinct from earlier book announcements and from possible other editions. The bibliographic claim is limited to this edition. The book itself was not read; publisher promotional judgments and endorsement blurbs are not independent assessments. Earlier editorial employment is cross-checked against Rhodes and Columbia biographies.

The candidate is described as Freeland with Volodymyr Groysman, photographed 22 December 2017. Sikander cropped the image on 7 April 2018; that is not its capture date. Candidate dimensions are 615×813. Commons author field is the government gallery URL, not a named photographer; preserve institutional source and crop credit without inventing an individual. The government gallery page timed out. Original download on 18 November 2026 failed with curl 22, HTTP 403 and reported HTTP 000; referenced cache is absent. Identity, colour, actual resolution and crop suitability remain visually unverified.
